brands.description: Happi Planet creates effective, eco-friendly home care products powered by nature. From plant-based detergents to natural floor cleaners, we're making sustainable cleaning accessible for Indian households. Our products are tough on stains but gentle on skin and the planet.

target_audience.psychographics: Urban Indian families who want effective cleaning without harmful chemicals. Concerned about skin allergies, environmental impact, and family health. Value transparency in ingredients. Willing to pay premium for sustainable products that actually work.

unique_selling_points: India's 1st foaming formulation for less scrubbing
Refill pods to reduce plastic waste by 80%
Gentle on skin - no rashes or allergies
Works as well as chemical cleaners
Safe for homes with kids and pets

campaign_goals.primary_objective: Increase brand awareness among eco-conscious urban families
campaign_goals.secondary_objective: Drive trial of refill pod system and reduce plastic usage
campaign_goals.campaign_type: Product education + lifestyle integration + sustainability messaging
key_messages: Effective cleaning doesn't need harsh chemicals
Switch to sustainable without compromising performance
Safe for your family, kind to the planet

creator_preferences.engagement_priority: High engagement and authentic community critical
creator_preferences.content_authenticity: Must genuinely care about sustainability and show actual product usage in daily life
creator_preferences.content_style: Authentic home content, educational, family-focused, sustainability angle, before/after cleaning demos
creator_preferences.language_preference: Bilingual Hindi + English preferred for urban reach
must_avoid: Beauty-only content without home care angle

past_successful_partnerships: Sustainability advocates with home care focus
avoid_partnerships_with: Pure luxury lifestyle without eco angle
brands.brand_voice: Friendly, educational, empowering, relatable, slightly playful but informative

must_include: Actual product usage in daily home routine
Refill pod system and plastic reduction angle

challenges: Price sensitivity - need to justify premium
opportunities: Mothers seeking safer products for kids

brands.description: Upside Health is revolutionizing Indian desserts and snacks with no added sugar, no gluten, and no compromise on taste. From guilt-free Tiramisu to protein-rich Laddoos, we're proving that healthy can be delicious. Real ingredients, real taste, zero guilt.

target_audience.income_level: Upper Middle Class to Affluent (₹10L-₹30L+ annual income)
target_audience.psychographics: Health-conscious urban Indians who refuse to compromise on taste. Fitness enthusiasts, diabetics, PCOS/thyroid patients, and calorie-conscious individuals who still crave desserts. Value premium quality, willing to pay 2-3x regular prices for genuinely healthy alternatives.

unique_selling_points: No added sugar, sweetened with dates/jaggery/stevia
No gluten, no preservatives, no seed oils
Premium desserts: Tiramisu, Brownies, Cheesecake, Mithai
Made fresh in Mumbai, delivered across India

campaign_goals.primary_objective: Drive online orders and subscriptions for desserts and mithai
campaign_goals.secondary_objective: Position as THE premium healthy dessert brand in India
campaign_goals.campaign_type: Taste proof + lifestyle aspiration + educational content

creator_preferences.engagement_priority: Balance of reach and engagement - need conversion potential
creator_preferences.content_authenticity: Must demonstrate actual healthy lifestyle - gym content, meal prep, wellness journey
creator_preferences.content_style: Aspirational yet authentic, educational, food porn worthy, fitness integration, honest taste reviews
creator_preferences.language_preference: Primarily English + Hindi for metro audience
must_avoid: Junk food promoters or inconsistent health messaging

budget.affiliate_commission: 12% on all orders from creator codes

past_successful_partnerships: Fitness influencers who share cheat meal alternatives
brands.brand_voice: Honest, aspirational but achievable, slightly cheeky, premium but relatable, unapologetically quality-focused

must_avoid: Weight loss guarantees or medical claims

challenges: High price point vs traditional mithai

special_requirements.product_samples: Must send product samples for genuine reviews
special_requirements.exclusivity: No promotion of direct competitor healthy dessert brands during campaign + 2 months

brands.description: FitGear Pro is India's premium gym utility brand, creating high-quality, durable fitness accessories for serious gym-goers. From premium gym towels and resistance bands to ergonomic gym bags and shaker bottles, we design products that enhance your workout experience. Built for performance, designed for the Indian fitness enthusiast who refuses to compromise on quality.

target_audience.income_level: Middle Class to Upper Middle Class (₹6L-₹25L annual income)
target_audience.psychographics: Dedicated gym-goers and fitness enthusiasts who train 3-5 times a week. Value quality, durability, and performance over price. They invest in their fitness journey and see gym accessories as essential tools, not luxuries. Active on fitness communities, follow workout routines, and are influenced by fitness influencers and trainers.

brand_values: Value for money without compromising quality
unique_selling_points: Durable construction - products last 2-3x longer than competitors
Ergonomic designs tested by professional trainers
Wide range: gym towels, resistance bands, gym bags, shaker bottles, gym gloves
Available online and in 200+ gym retail stores across metros

campaign_goals.primary_objective: Increase brand awareness among active gym-goers and drive online sales
campaign_goals.secondary_objective: Position as the go-to brand for quality gym accessories in India
campaign_goals.campaign_type: Product demonstration + lifestyle integration + performance messaging
key_messages: Gear up for greatness - quality tools for serious training
Built to last, designed to perform
Your fitness journey deserves the best equipment
From gym floor to home workouts - we've got you covered

creator_preferences.follower_range: 100K-600K (mid-tier to macro influencers with fitness credibility)
creator_preferences.engagement_priority: High engagement critical - need active fitness community
creator_preferences.content_authenticity: Must be genuine gym-goers who train regularly and can demonstrate product usage in real workouts. Should show actual gym sessions, not just lifestyle shots.
creator_preferences.content_style: Authentic gym content, workout demonstrations, product reviews in action, transformation journeys, fitness tips, honest performance reviews
creator_preferences.language_preference: Bilingual Hindi + English preferred, regional languages (Tamil, Telugu) for South India
must_avoid: Creators who don't actually go to gym or train
Pure lifestyle/beauty content without fitness focus
Creators promoting competing gym equipment brands
Creators with fake engagement or bought followers

budget.affiliate_commission: 10% on all orders from creator codes

past_successful_partnerships: Fitness influencers showing gym routines with our products
avoid_partnerships_with: Creators promoting competing gym equipment brands
Pure supplement-focused creators without training content
Creators who don't show actual gym training
Fake transformation or misleading fitness content
Creators with poor engagement despite high follower count
brands.brand_voice: Motivational, authentic, performance-focused, community-driven, slightly aspirational but relatable, no-nonsense approach to fitness

must_include: Actual product usage during gym workouts
Honest reviews about product quality and durability
must_avoid: Overly staged or fake workout scenarios
Medical or health claims beyond product features

challenges: Price sensitivity - need to justify premium over local alternatives
Trust in online quality - need to prove durability
Competition from international brands and local manufacturers
Seasonal demand variations (monsoon affects gym attendance)
opportunities: Rising gym culture in Tier 1 and Tier 2 cities
Growing awareness of quality gym accessories
Increasing disposable income in target demographic

special_requirements.product_samples: Must send full product range for creators to test and review
special_requirements.content_approval: Workout demonstrations must be safe and follow proper form
special_requirements.exclusivity: No promotion of direct competitor gym accessory brands during campaign + 3 months
special_requirements.gym_access: Creators should have access to gym for authentic content creation

brands.description: Silver Screen Studios is a leading Indian movie production company focused on creating mainstream, high-quality cinema for theatrical and OTT audiences. With a strong portfolio of commercial and content-driven films, the studio leverages digital creators and influencer-led promotions to drive hype, audience engagement, and box office success.

target_audience.income_level: Middle Class to Upper Middle Class (₹5L-₹25L annual income)
target_audience.psychographics: Urban movie enthusiasts who actively follow film releases, trailers, and reviews before deciding what to watch. They enjoy in-depth movie analysis, honest opinions, and behind-the-scenes content. Strongly influenced by trusted reviewers and creators when choosing theatrical or OTT releases.

unique_selling_points: Big-budget theatrical releases with strong storytelling
Strong presence across theatrical and OTT platforms

campaign_goals.primary_objective: Drive movie awareness and footfall for theatrical and OTT releases
campaign_goals.secondary_objective: Build strong pre-release buzz and positive word-of-mouth
campaign_goals.campaign_type: Movie review amplification + trailer reactions + discussion-based promotion
key_messages: Worth watching in theatres / on OTT

target_metrics.conversions: High intent signals via ticket booking clicks and OTT views

creator_preferences.engagement_priority: High credibility and audience trust more important than pure reach
creator_preferences.content_authenticity: Creators must have a strong reputation for honest movie reviews and film discussions
creator_preferences.content_style: Movie reviews, trailer reactions, spoiler-free analysis, audience polls, discussion-driven content
creator_preferences.language_preference: Hindi + English preferred, regional language reviewers for dubbed/regional releases
must_avoid: Creators known for paid-positive reviews only
Creators with controversial or toxic fanbases

avoid_partnerships_with: Creators demanding script approval of reviews
brands.brand_voice: Confident, cinematic, audience-focused, respectful of honest opinions, hype-driven but grounded

must_include: Trailer or scene references where applicable

opportunities: Strong influence of movie reviewers in India
Rise of discussion-based YouTube cinema channels
Growing Tier 1 audience for content-driven films

brands.description: GameSphere India is a leading gaming and esports platform focused on competitive gaming, live streams, tournaments, and gaming communities. Catering to India's fast-growing gamer population, GameSphere collaborates with top gaming creators to promote games, hardware, and esports events across PC, console, and mobile gaming ecosystems.

target_audience.income_level: Lower Middle Class to Upper Middle Class (₹3L-₹20L annual income)
target_audience.psychographics: Young, digitally native gamers who spend significant time watching and playing games. Highly influenced by gaming creators and streamers. Value skill, entertainment, and community. Open to brand integrations when they feel organic to gaming content.

campaign_goals.primary_objective: Increase platform adoption and engagement among Indian gamers
campaign_goals.secondary_objective: Position GameSphere as a hub for competitive gaming and esports
campaign_goals.campaign_type: Gameplay integration + live streaming + tournament promotion

creator_preferences.engagement_priority: Live audience interaction and watch time critical
creator_preferences.content_authenticity: Creators must actively play games and engage live with their audience
creator_preferences.content_style: Live gameplay, tournament streams, reaction clips, community challenges, skill-based content
creator_preferences.language_preference: Hindi + English preferred, regional language creators for mass reach
must_avoid: Creators with toxic or abusive communities

brands.brand_voice: Energetic, competitive, youth-focused, community-driven, fun and hype-oriented

must_include: Live gameplay or real game footage
Fair play and community guidelines mention

challenges: Device and internet limitations for some users
opportunities: Rapid growth of gaming and esports in India
Strong creator influence in gaming decisions
Increasing acceptance of gaming as a career

brands.description: InkRiver Publishing is a modern Indian publishing house focused on fiction, non-fiction, and contemporary literature. With a strong emphasis on storytelling, author discovery, and reader communities, InkRiver actively collaborates with book reviewers, literary creators, and reading communities to promote books organically.

target_audience.income_level: Middle Class to Upper Middle Class (₹4L-₹20L annual income)
target_audience.psychographics: Avid readers who actively seek recommendations before purchasing books. Enjoy discovering new authors, participating in reading challenges, and engaging with bookish communities online. Value honest reviews, aesthetics, and emotional connection to stories.

unique_selling_points: Strong focus on debut Indian authors
Wide genre range: fiction, memoirs, business, poetry
National distribution across online and offline channels

campaign_goals.primary_objective: Increase book awareness and drive sales for new releases
campaign_goals.secondary_objective: Build long-term trust with book reviewers and reading communities
campaign_goals.campaign_type: Book reviews + reading vlogs + author interactions

creator_preferences.engagement_priority: High trust and consistent reader engagement
creator_preferences.content_authenticity: Creators must genuinely read and discuss books, not just aesthetic posts
creator_preferences.content_style: Book reviews, reading vlogs, bookshelf tours, aesthetic reels, reading challenges
creator_preferences.language_preference: English primarily, Hindi for select Indian titles

brands.description: DermaRoot is a dermatologist-backed Indian skincare brand focused on science-led, barrier-friendly formulations. Designed for Indian skin and climate, DermaRoot offers targeted solutions for acne, pigmentation, sensitivity, and barrier repair.

target_audience.income_level: Middle Class to Upper Middle Class (₹5L-₹18L annual income)
target_audience.psychographics: Ingredient-conscious skincare users who research products before buying. Prefer science-backed solutions over trends. Value transparency, dermatologist opinions, and visible skin improvement.

creator_preferences.content_authenticity: Creators must understand ingredients and routines
creator_preferences.content_style: Routine breakdowns, ingredient education, skin journeys

brands.description: GlowVeda blends time-tested Ayurvedic wisdom with modern dermatological science to create gentle yet effective skincare solutions for Indian skin. The brand focuses on long-term skin health using clinically validated natural ingredients, free from harsh chemicals.

target_audience.income_level: Middle Class to Upper Middle Class (₹4L-₹18L annual income)
target_audience.psychographics: Consumers who prefer natural and holistic skincare but still want visible results. They are cautious of harsh actives, follow ingredient education content, and value brands that balance tradition with science.

unique_selling_points: Ayurvedic ingredients backed by modern testing
No parabens, sulfates, or synthetic fragrance
Formulated for Indian climate and skin concerns
Focus on skin barrier and balance

campaign_goals.primary_objective: Build trust and credibility in holistic skincare
campaign_goals.campaign_type: Education-led skincare routines + skin journey storytelling

creator_preferences.content_authenticity: Creators must genuinely follow natural or mindful skincare routines
creator_preferences.content_style: Routine videos, ingredient explainers, calm aesthetic reels, skin journeys

brands.brand_voice: Calm, nurturing, educational, rooted yet modern

challenges: Skepticism about efficacy of natural skincare

brands.description: ShaadiCraft is a premium wedding planning and design company specializing in bespoke Indian weddings. From intimate destination weddings to grand multi-day celebrations, ShaadiCraft curates personalized experiences with a strong focus on aesthetics, storytelling, and flawless execution.

target_audience.income_level: Upper Middle Class to Affluent (₹15L-₹50L+ annual income)
target_audience.psychographics: Modern couples and families seeking stress-free, visually stunning weddings. They value personalization, premium service, and Instagram-worthy moments. Willing to invest in planners who can manage end-to-end execution.

campaign_goals.secondary_objective: Build aspiration and brand recall among engaged couples

creator_preferences.content_authenticity: Creators must showcase real weddings or planning journeys
creator_preferences.content_style: Wedding reels, decor walkthroughs, BTS planning, bride journeys

brands.description: WanderRoots curates immersive travel experiences focused on culture, nature, and local connection. From offbeat domestic destinations to international experiential trips, the brand emphasizes slow travel, authentic stays, and meaningful journeys.

target_audience.income_level: Middle Class to Upper Middle Class (₹6L-₹25L annual income)
target_audience.psychographics: Experience-driven travelers who prefer meaningful journeys over luxury tourism. They seek local immersion, unique itineraries, and trusted travel curation. Influenced by authentic travel creators rather than commercial ads.

campaign_goals.primary_objective: Drive bookings for curated travel experiences
campaign_goals.secondary_objective: Build brand aspiration among urban travelers

creator_preferences.engagement_priority: High storytelling quality and save rates
creator_preferences.content_authenticity: Creators must travel and document real experiences
creator_preferences.content_style: Cinematic reels, travel vlogs, itinerary breakdowns, local culture stories

brands.description: AstroSetu is a digital astrology and spiritual guidance platform connecting users with verified astrologers for personalized consultations, horoscopes, and remedial guidance. Blending traditional Vedic astrology with modern digital access, AstroSetu focuses on trust, authenticity, and long-term spiritual well-being.

target_audience.income_level: Middle Class to Upper Middle Class (₹4L-₹20L annual income)
target_audience.psychographics: Individuals seeking guidance in career, relationships, health, and life decisions. They believe in astrology as a supportive tool rather than blind prediction. Value astrologers with calm communication, ethical practices, and clear explanations. Strongly influenced by astrologer creators they trust.

unique_selling_points: Focus on guidance, not fear or superstition
Personalized consultations via chat and call
Combination of astrology, numerology, and tarot
Transparent pricing with no hidden remedies push

campaign_goals.primary_objective: Onboard high-quality astrologer creators and drive user consultations
campaign_goals.secondary_objective: Build trust and credibility among astrology-seeking audiences
campaign_goals.campaign_type: Astrology education + live guidance sessions + creator-led trust building

creator_preferences.engagement_priority: High trust, saves, and comment quality over viral reach
creator_preferences.content_authenticity: Creators must actively practice astrology or spiritual guidance and explain concepts calmly and responsibly
creator_preferences.content_style: Horoscope explainers, live astrology sessions, Q&A, educational reels, myth-busting content
creator_preferences.language_preference: Hindi + English preferred, regional language astrologers encouraged
must_avoid: Astrology meme pages without educational value

avoid_partnerships_with: Creators pushing expensive gemstones or remedies aggressively
brands.brand_voice: Calm, reassuring, ethical, educational, spiritually grounded

challenges: Low trust due to fake astrologers
